title: FIL314 — hourBurn Repeated-Call Token Price Manipulation Analysis
root_cause: Repeatedly calling `hourBurn()` ~6,000 times burns the token supply, distorting the spot price calculation in `getAmountOut()`, enabling excessive BNB withdrawal via subsequent `transfer()` calls
other_code:
Attacker
  │
  ├─→ [1] Send 0.05 BNB → Buy FIL314 tokens
  │
  ├─→ [2] Call hourBurn() ~6,000 times
  │         └─ tokenReserve decreases significantly
  │         └─ getAmountOut(sell) return value increases
  │
  ├─→ [3] Confirm manipulated price via getAmountOut()
  │
  ├─→ [4] transfer(FIL314Contract, tokenAmount)
  │         └─ Receive BNB at manipulated price
  │
  └─→ [5] ~14 BNB profit
